item.title: Police left searching for driver after truck rolls
item.description: Patrols searched the area but the driver could not be located. Image: SAPOL South Australia Police were left searching for the driver after a truck carrying scrap metal rolled in the Adelaide suburb of Wingfield yesterday afternoon. When emergency services arrived at the Wilkins Road incident shortly after 2.30pm on March 8, the driver had left the scene. item.title: Childhood passion turns into full-time career for truck lover
item.description: Jayden drives for Hi-Haul Transport, moving heavy equipment around the country. Based in Bayswater, Jayden Perry has been driving trucks for around 13 years, turning what started as a childhood passion into a full-time career. These days he drives for Hi-Haul Transport, moving heavy equipment around the country. Jayden’s introduction to trucking came early.
